title: UI visual-polish defect sweep against the AAA brief without layout invention
outcome: Existing UI surfaces conform to the GOVERNOR.md UX rules (panel tokens #2B2B2B/#323232, pasteboard #1F1F1F, copper accent #E07A2F only on active tool/selection, Segoe UI, radius 0-2px, honest empty states, distinct semantic icons): every measured deviation from the token spec is corrected in place with no new layout, no new components, and no descriptive prose.
before: GOVERNOR.md UX Rules define the desk spec; VIRO-0016's audit may surface cosmetic deviations, and no token-conformance sweep exists. This packet is deliberately scoped to defect correction inside existing UI/CSS surfaces only.
after: Token conformance verified programmatically or by enumerated inspection report; all deviations fixed; before/after captures document each intentional change; no functional behavior change.
acceptance: Enumerated deviation list committed with before/after evidence per item.
Color/radius/token conformance verified against the spec values.
Accent color appears only on active tool/selection states.
No functional regression: full chrome suites green.
npx tsc --noEmit, npm run test:chrome and npm run build pass.

builder.notes: Builder zcode-polish-pc2 (pc-cloud1), branch agent/viro-0017/zcode-gov-audit-pc1 based on local main 5014465 (report commit authored by the first seat zcode-polish-pc1 on a 72b05f0 base, rebased onto 5014465 by this seat; VIRO-0014 stack between the two touches no chrome path - empty diff on index.html/src/chrome/src/styles 72b05f0..5014465). Method (docs/reviews/0017-visual-polish-sweep.md): static accent/radius/font enumeration + live computed-style audit (headless Chromium, same flags as playwright.config.ts) of the running desk on 127.0.0.1:5184 across five driven states (rest / 2-layer selection+align hover / recovery bar / Anchor studio / Projects dialog). Findings: 4 in-lease deviations D1-D4 (fixed), 10 allowed-state groups A1-A10 (dismissed with per-state evidence), 2 out-of-lease deviations D5 (src/styles/desk.css .btn.default ring) and D6 (nd-pv guide strokes) returned to the Governor unedited. Fixes, all inside the lease: (D1) src/chrome/desk.css .recover-primary solid var(--accent) CTA -> the .btn/.anc-btn token set (#3d3d3d fill, #1a1a1a border, --ink text; Restore stays distinct from Discard by fill alone); (D2) .align-btn/.proj-btn/.recover-btn :hover border var(--accent) -> #3d3d3d neutral hover step; (D3) #g-anchor .anc-btn-default and .anc-mini-default persistent copper rings removed, non-accent ink emphasis kept, no replacement ornament; (D4) dead governance prose removed from #g-anchor static markup (mountAnchorPanel strips it at init, zero painted-pixel delta; an explanatory HTML comment remains). Before/after evidence: node_modules/.polish-probe.mjs (uncommitted tool, 0016 precedent) ran twice with the fix diff stashed/applied; per-item captures in node_modules/.polish-shots-{before,after}/ (recover-bar.png, align-btn-hover.png, anchor-panel.png, desk-full.png, projects-dialog.png). Probe diff: exactly the D1/D2 accent hits removed, zero accent hits added in any state; radius violations 0 in all states; tokens resolve #2b2b2b/#323232/#1f1f1f/#e07a2f, radius 1px. Enforcement: tests/visual-polish-tokens.spec.ts (5) + tests/visual-polish-chrome.spec.ts (8) + tests/visual-polish.playwright.config.ts (seat-local runner that runs the identical suite on the assigned port 5184 because canonical 5173 reuseExistingServer can silently target a foreign worktree on a shared box). Gates on candidate: npx tsc --noEmit clean; test:unit 316/316; full Playwright suite on 5184 29/29 (incl. VIRO-0016 a11y-keyboard and the two new suites); node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build complete (web dist + electron preload). No functional change: only CSS declarations and one dead markup block touched.
